summary: Bassett Furniture Industries filed a Form 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing solely a routine quarterly dividend declaration. The board declared $0.20 per common share, payable November 27, 2026, to holders of record November 13, 2026. No strategic, transactional, or structural event is present; the filing is a standard capital-return announcement accompanied by a news release exhibit. No advisor, premium, stake, or regulatory clock applies. Watch is limited to ordinary dividend sustainability and payout coverage, not a special-situation risk-arb angle.
